response.description: Foundry IQ supported Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers as federated knowledge sources, is generally available. Customers register an MCP server as a read-only knowledge source in Foundry IQ. MCP knowledge sources participate in Foundry IQ cross-source selection alongside other knowledge sources, such as web search and unstructured data in blob storage synced into Azure AI Search vector indexes. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: MCP server knowledge sources in Foundry IQ
